content.comment_body: I have two questions regarding [product_name]: - Is it possible to create reusable routines with [product_name] or [product_name]? - How can an external display unit be connected to communicate directly with [product_name]? Thanks in advance [user_name]
Regarding the routines, could you clarify what type of functionality you want to implement?

Hello, a [product_name] program can be saved to a PC or memory card and transferred to multiple [product_name] devices. However, you cannot create parametrizable subroutines in [product_name] like function or function blocks found in [product_name]. There are two versions of [product_name]: with and without display, but you can't convert between types or add an additional display to a [product_name]. Some indicators can be managed via the digital outputs, though.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are exploring methods for creating reusable routines similar to those available in other systems and for connecting external display units to [product_name]. Currently, [product_name] and its associated software lack support for parametrizable subroutines and cannot natively integrate with external display hardware, restricting both modular coding and hardware extensibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to develop reusable routines and connect extra display units directly to [product_name] hardware.
